QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_16

question.text: For Cat III AIFs, continuing interest by Sponsor or Investment Manager must be not less than:

answer.text: 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore, whichever is lower
2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore, whichever is higher
5% of corpus or INR 10 crore, whichever is lower
10% of corpus or INR 20 crore, whichever is lower

explanation.text: The Logic: Cat III AIFs require continuing interest of 5% of corpus OR INR 10 crore, WHICHEVER IS LOWER. (Cat I/II: 2.5% / INR 5 crore, whichever is lower.) This is the single most-tested Cat III vs Cat I/II discriminator. The Trap: Options A and B are Cat I/II numbers. Option D invents a higher threshold. The 'whichever is LOWER' qualifier is also a common swap-trap. Note: The workbook fixes the 5%/INR 10 crore (lower) Cat III continuing-interest threshold and the Cat I/II contrast; sponsor-funding launch planning and exam-frequency commentary are not part of the syllabus.
